verses.2: And when he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was afterward an hungred.
verses.3: And when the tempter came to him, he said, If thou be the Son of God, command that these stones be made bread.
verses.5: Then the devil taketh him up into the holy city, and setteth him on a pinnacle of the temple,
verses.6: And saith unto him, If thou be the Son of God, cast thyself down: for it is written, He shall give his angels charge concerning thee: and in their hands they shall bear thee up, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.
verses.8: Again, the devil taketh him up into an exceeding high mountain, and sheweth him all the kingdoms of the world, and the glory of them;
verses.9: And saith unto him, All these things will I give thee, if thou wilt fall down and worship me.
verses.11: Then the devil leaveth him, and, behold, angels came and ministered unto him.
verses.14: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying,
verses.16: The people which sat in darkness saw great light; and to them which sat in the region and shadow of death light is sprung up.
verses.20: And they straightway left their nets, and followed him.
verses.21: And going on from thence, he saw other two brethren,
verses.22: And they immediately left the ship and their father, and followed him.
